lesson: A case set is frozen PER UNIT and is therefore blind by construction to any defect that lives BETWEEN units — and `production_path: true` does not close that. What `production_path` makes decidable is an INTRA-unit signature (a required observation seen only through a test-local shim, a fixture-only path, a helper called directly, a hand-built input that bypasses the real caller). The cross-unit form has a different shape: unit A edits a file, unit B owns the predicate that polices the class A's edit belongs to, and neither unit's declared observations quantify over the other's diff, so both discharge green while the class regresses. The trap is that a run whose SUBJECT is a defect class is the most exposed, not the least: it edits the policing predicate most, and every unit reads 'that class is our topic, someone is watching it'. A fully discharged case set is evidence about DECLARED observations inside one unit and is not evidence that a change is safe across units. This class is OPEN, not mitigated — nothing in this repository observes a defect that lives between units, and Phase 8's whole-run hunt covers one signature only.
how_to_apply: (1) Never read a green `case_set_discharge[]` as cross-unit safety; say what it is — declared coverage plus non-vacuity inside one unit. (2) When a run's subject IS a defect class, run a WHOLE-FILE census of that class per commit against the run's BASE commit, never HEAD (L27), and assert the two sides are not byte-identical before publishing: `for c in <base> <c1> <c2> HEAD; do git show $c:<path> > /private/tmp/vr_$c.py; python3 plugins/dag/skills/dag/scripts/tests/i48_crash_class.py --census --file /private/tmp/vr_$c.py; done` plus `python3 .../i48_crash_class.py --provenance --base <base>` for the line-number-independent multiset diff by (kind, src). Confirm the base is the direct parent (`git rev-parse <c1>^`). (3) Publish GROSS (added / closed / shipped), never net — net answers 'did this get worse' and hides 'what did we do': +2 net here concealed four introductions. (4) Assign the census to a unit whose case set quantifies over the WHOLE FILE across the run's commit range, not over one unit's diff — a diff-scoped check can never see a class its own unit did not touch.
